steps.prompt_exact: Can you make a small laundromat sock-sorting game in one HTML file, where I match patterned sock pairs into the right machines, lose points for wrong-machine drops, and finish a little customer basket?
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a one-file laundromat sock sorting game with patterned washers, a 12-sock basket, score/pair/basket HUD, drag/drop, tap selection, wrong-machine penalties, restart, and completion overlay.

code_blocks.content:
Laundromat Sock Sort 🧺

Score: 0
Pairs: 0/6
Basket: 12

Match each sock to the washer with the same pattern. Two correct socks complete one customer pair. Wrong washer drops cost points.

Drag or tap a sock, then tap the right washer.

Basket Finished!

steps.notes: Usable as a click/touch/drag game, but not accepted as final because it lacked a keyboard play path.

steps.prompt_exact: This is close, but I need a real keyboard control path too. Add keyboard play so I can move between socks and washers, choose a sock, send it to a washer, and keep the click/touch controls working in the same one-file HTML.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a full revised one-file HTML game adding keyboard focus/navigation, Enter or Space to select socks, number keys 1-4 for washers, Escape cancel, washer key labels, and retained click/touch/drag behavior.

code_blocks.content:
Laundromat Sock Sort 🧺

Score: 0
Pairs: 0/6
Basket: 12

Match each sock to the washer with the same pattern. Drag/tap works, or use keyboard: ←/→ choose socks, Enter pick sock, 1-4 send to washer, Esc cancel.

Drag/tap a sock, or use ←/→ then Enter.

Basket Finished!
